title: Insurance coverages available under plan.
bodyText: All properties qualifying for coverage under the plan of operation shall be eligible for the standard fire policy and extended coverage endorsement. The association shall provide additional coverages when directed by the commissioner or when approved by the commissioner. Nothing in this section shall be construed as authorizing the association to provide hurricane coverage.
bodyHtml: §431:21-109  Insurance coverages available under plan.  All properties qualifying for coverage under the plan of operation shall be eligible for the standard fire policy and extended coverage endorsement.  The association shall provide additional coverages when directed by the commissioner or when approved by the commissioner.  Nothing in this section shall be construed as authorizing the association to provide hurricane coverage. [L 1991, c 284, pt of §2; am L 1997, c 14, §1; am L 2025, c 296, §6]
